full_name: Hyun kyung Kim | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2008–2009 Arts David and Roberta Logie Fellow and Radcliffe-Harvard Film Study Center Fellow Independent Filmmaker (South Korea)
bio: Hyun kyung Kim is an independent filmmaker from Seoul, Korea, who is interested in discovering buried emotions and relationships between human beings through filmmaking.
